method: Reconstructed the GMSI credit-bearing route from adopted Appendix I and the dated cohort catalogue, rechecked specific course preparation and the mobility variants, then reconsidered the actual workbook courses and finished audience record. This second analytical pass was by the same AI.
findings: The English full-time GMSI track is distinct from the Dutch OMW track. The adopted table and dated plan give 60 EC in each year, including one 30 EC mobility window and one 12 EC thesis. Year-one Wicked Problems 101 carries seven EC including skills work. The year-two law title includes EU law. GROW entries carry zero EC.

The 42 EC ordinary BSA threshold comes from the current OER. Financial and Project Management supplies the stated prior knowledge for Advanced Project Management. Causal Analysis Techniques precedes the quantitative practicum, and WP101 and WP202 precede the intervention course. The programme provides 120 EC after year two, meeting the standard spring thesis gate. Thesis circles support individual work and a defence.

The mobility entries describe alternatives for a total of thirty EC. An internship of twelve, eighteen or twenty-four EC is completed with eighteen, twelve or six minor EC, or a full thirty-EC internship may fill the window. Study abroad is thirty EC or twenty-four plus a six-EC Tilburg course. The window is left open, with no invented course content or stacking of alternative variants.

The closest UCR option supplies organisational behaviour, governance and multiple empirical methods. The policy option builds depth in institutions, law and displacement-related social inquiry, while the enterprise option uses social movements and inequality, product and customer research and sustainability governance. General methods and enterprise courses are appropriate to their bounded roles. The specialist project, intervention and research structure at Tilburg remains distinct.

Read forty-four selected titles and description texts, twenty-six external labels, six audience note anchors, three concepts, programme title, comparison messages, source links and optional-research placement. The review index and canonical both use Global Management of Social Issues, and the route records English instruction.
